title: Certify Jensen compiler feasibility for a hypothetical 145-split P104 profile
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This package records a conditional compiler-feasibility target at C=.0033 and C=.0033000005. It keeps PR5565's paid invoice fixed and hypothetically replaces145 distinct original rank-nine helper targets per FULL by independent rank-four/rank-five targets, with no additional paid jobs. The complete hypothetical bill is66726 paid jobs,15424 targets and rank surplus760. No physical145-split word or new kappa is supplied.

Applying the credited weighted-Jensen inequality to the existing rank-one-tail endpoint gives a useful sufficient criterion. With rank-mass weights w_r=p_r*r/P1 and mu=sum(w_r*ln r), ln(c)>mu implies gamma_C<alpha; if b*B<=P1, delta<=gamma_C. The fixed-offset application includes the explicit correction at the diagnostic point, where u>C.

The one fixed tuple is cutoff12, floor13, u=.0033000005, rho=.99985, tensor power32768, reserve1e-6, theta39/40 and logarithm power22000. At the tested point:

- raw surplus exceeds .389976323560029949280648;
- gamma is below .999780978737406788178684 and delta below .830893792830358397762175;
- the complete normalized paid bound, including both coefficient-two splitting/completion terms, is below .949537674806338372278839;
- capacity, initial range and shifted exits pass; the least14e9-grid index is1185397, with predecessor1185396 rejected and H=16595558000000000.

This changes the earlier fixed17/18 completion contract. Its scoped obstruction remains valid. Jensen's theorem, the rank-one-tail endpoint and the generic compiler are credited reuse; the contribution is the transparent criterion, source-bound numerical application and reproducible obligation boundary.

## Task and overlap

Task `scalar-to-moment`, scope changed to a hypothetical numerical compiler benchmark before construction. Scientific source: PR5565 head `9af814164b9dfc21f19ec737959d67cb71488c95`. Parent credits are removed exactly; produced children and current13/historical15 splits receive no additional credit. `INVOICE.json` contains every local, query, idle and main-target coefficient.

The contribution uses available canonical ancestor `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`; this is distinct from the latest observed main `6cf7a683f447b9f1e2333791907fd92be5009a63`. The bounded22:33 source snapshot has unchanged guidance and selected kappa .003027288235, and records the different PR5612 word at `faa9f6dbe6b8cc4a996d3edeca71823056453e1a`, author conditional kappa .00310299. No automatic source or target transfer is claimed.

The prepublication check found no competing145-split/c12-b13/Jensen parameter claim. Active physical cut-capacity, basis and composition work remains with its authors; this package asserts no physical capacity or available bank. Earlier5592/5596/5597 merges were for archive only, partially reviewed, without scientific or selected-frontier admission.

## Validation

Original frozen normal/-O qualification:2.8162s, sampled peak46,694,400bytes; all24 strength-labelled controls reject and every scientific output byte agrees. Result SHA256: `938f8b2fbbf60da5cccf257f47dd88c06aae7ad09c4fa8a2d87470b35a8797e2`.

Portable metadata and six custody controls pass. Registered normal/-O replay passed in3.5233s, sampled peak78,508,032bytes. A relocated read-only Git-free optimized export with path spaces and empty PATH passed in1.7114s, sampled peak51,224,576bytes; all54 exported files remain unchanged. Exact53-file committed-byte/source-history checks pass at published fork commit `771cb09233cef478066da9286cb31ac844112f1c`, tree `52fc7d2c7ad01aa89b4b0454077c0fd8d91ad355`. All runs use the unchanged150s/512MiB serial guard. Hosted CI is pending submission.

Reproduce: `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-jensen-compiler-benchmark`.

The qualified positive-C interval engine is unchanged. Rational transport avoids negative-C calls; the outward1e-320 mesh preserves tiny capacity bounds. Original request, checker, engine, proof sources, root acceptance, receipts and independent static review are preserved. No independent numerical implementation, human review or formal acceptance is claimed.

## Open next questions

The missing premise is an actual compatible construction of145 independent target splits, including new input roles and legal native/whole-job/product/owned semantics. Splitting a paid operator on one owner does not create that target credit. Actual scalar, basis, movement, normalization, growth, denominators, expanded U/R/W/P/G, precision, storage, tape, stock and applicable BIT/outer obligations remain open. No old1000/1100 ordinary cap transfers. No physical search, source retarget or funded kappa follows automatically from this numerical benchmark.
